requirements.title: JSON-only stdout in agent mode
requirements.rationale: Agents parse stdout; a single stray byte breaks them.

criteria.condition: AF_AGENT=1 is set in the environment
criteria.action: suppress the banner and spinner and write only the command's JSON result to stdout
criteria.contract: stdout parses as exactly one JSON object

setup: a spec root with two specs exists
check.pseudocode: r = run(env={AF_AGENT:'1'}, 'spec list'); assert parse_json(r.stdout).ok == true; assert not contains(r.stdout, BANNER_TEXT)

criteria.condition: a command finishes and AF_AGENT=1 is set and --quiet was also passed
criteria.action: behave exactly as with AF_AGENT=1 alone
criteria.contract: identical stdout, stderr and exit code

setup: a spec root with two specs exists
check.pseudocode: a = run(env, 'spec list'); b = run(env, 'spec --quiet list'); assert a == b

criteria.action: for any command and any arguments, in agent mode, write progress and diagnostics to stderr only
criteria.contract: stdout parses as JSON; every diagnostic line appears on stderr only

check.pseudocode: for cmd in COMMANDS: r = run(env, cmd); assert is_json(r.stdout)

criteria.condition: a command returns an error while AF_AGENT=1 is set
criteria.action: write {"ok": false, "error": <message>} to stdout and exit
criteria.contract: exit code 1; stdout is {"ok": false, "error": string}

check.pseudocode: r = run(env, 'spec status 99_missing'); assert r.code == 1; j = parse_json(r.stdout); assert j.ok == false and len(j.error) > 0

criteria.condition: stdout is a closed pipe while the JSON result is written
criteria.action: discard the write error and keep the command's own exit code
criteria.contract: no panic; exit code is the command's, not a write error

setup: stdout is connected to a reader that closes before the payload is written
check.pseudocode: r = run_with_closed_stdout(env, 'spec list'); assert r.code == 0; assert not contains(r.stderr, 'panic')

execution_paths.title: Agent lists specs and parses the result

steps.action: detects agent mode before the banner would print
scans the spec root and builds the list payload
writes the payload as one JSON object to stdout and exits 0

setup: a spec root with one spec exists
end_state: stdout is one JSON object whose specs array has one entry
